about: Copy this file to <language code>.json in the kit's translations folder (Preferences > Add-ons > Maya Workflow Kit > Translations > Open Translations Folder), for example de_DE.json, fr_FR.json or ko_KR.json: the code is Blender's language code (Preferences > Interface > Language).
Replace the values with your translation. A value that is empty or still the English text is skipped, so you can translate a part and leave the rest.
The same English text can be listed in several sections (it is shown in several places); translating it once is enough, it is used everywhere it is shown.

Keep '...', leading / trailing spaces and placeholders as they are. Restart Blender or press Reload Translations to see the result; the kit follows Blender's interface language and its Translate switches.
